title: fix(pm): mailbox-open warns at open time when --close will leave the --head branch
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3yYQa743K3EEuBTKHDP1HE)_

Fixes #31385

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`mailbox-open.mjs` 以 `--head` 开信箱时,若分支名不是 `claude/mailbox-*`,在建 PR 之前(含 `--dry-run`)向 stderr 打印一条醒目警告:`--close` 会留下这个分支,并给出 `claude/mailbox-<slug>` 的拼法。
- 为什么改:云席位常用会话指定分支开信箱,收工 `--close` 时分支被留下,直到收工才发现;现在开信箱当场就看得到。
- 风险与回滚:只多一行 stderr 输出,退出码、relay 动作、删除围栏(`mailbox_branch_delete` / `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`)都不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `headLeftWarning` 与 `main()` 中调用它的两行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --seat domain:skills#2 --login zhuangjianguo --head claude/project-thread-a81t4h --dry-run`,预期 stderr 出现一条 `--close will LEAVE it` 警告并点名 `claude/mailbox-skills-2`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New pure `headLeftWarning(plan)` in `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`: for an open plan whose head was named with `--head` and does not match `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE` (imported from `fleet-write/ops.mjs`, never retyped), it returns one warning naming the head, saying `--close` will leave it, and naming `claude/mailbox-SLUG`. Null for the pushed default branch, a matching head, or a close.
- `main()` prints it once on stderr after the validator and before either the dry-run print or the live open, so it shows before the pull is created and on `--dry-run`. Exit code and stroke are unchanged.
- Header step ② notes the warning and that it is a warning, never a refusal (card ask 3).
- `--self-test`: one plan-level case (warns on a thread branch, names the slug spelling; silent on `claude/mailbox-*`, the default branch and a close) and one CLI case (dry run on `claude/project-thread-a81t4h`, the seat's own mailbox #31401 head: exactly one warning, exit 0, same actions file; a `claude/mailbox-skills-2` head prints none). Battery pins 11 to 12 and 7 to 8.
- Not touched, as ruled: `mailbox_branch_delete`, `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`: `✓ mailbox-open self-test: 89 cases in 10 batteries pass.` (was 87).
- `pnpm exec eslint scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Skip-changeset: `scripts/pm/**` only, nothing a package publishes moves.
- No ablation: the diff is a script (os-dev.md: scripts are not ablated); the self-test cases assert the warning's presence and absence directly.
